newsitem.title: USA: BASKETBALL-HARRICK TO COACH RHODE ISLAND.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-HARRICK TO COACH RHODE ISLAND.

text.p: Former UCLA coach Jim Harrick, who was fired before the start of the past season due to falsifying expense reports, was named head coach of the University of Rhode Island on Monday.
Harrick was the only coach interviewed for the position. He replaces Al Skinner, who took the head joba at Boston College.
Harrick, who coached UCLA to an NCAA Tournament title in 1995, becomes the 43rd new coach for the 1997-98 season.

"When we began searching for a new coach, we wanted to hire someone who would continue the great basketball tradition at the University of Rhode Island," said Rhode Island athletic director Ron Petro. "We believe Jim Harrick is the right man for the job."
